text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe's signature racewear has arrived, so I go looking for her to share the news. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In my frantic rush to find her, I drop my trainer badge somewhere! I look for it, but finding things is easier said than done in the dark…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you dropped this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe sneaks up on me like a shadow, my trainer badge in hand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …From the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can see… and hear everything from the shadows…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Things appear more colorful… more vivid…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It all sounds a little vague to me, but I'm sure she has her methods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moving on, I tell Manhattan Cafe about her racewear. She says she's eager to try it on, so we arrange to meet up at the track.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It feels cool to the touch, like the shade beneath a tree… and silky, like the dark of night…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It wraps around me like a shadow… Silent and tenacious…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Very much… With this racewear, I'm sure that—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh my, oh my! So that's what your racewear looks like. Care to join for me some experimental partner running?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …There's no telling where you'll appear from next, is there?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come now, no need to eye me so suspiciously. Are you not curious too? To see how racewear can affect one's running?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well… I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But I wouldn't mind running with you… I wanted to try something anyway…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is it okay if I go?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, under the brilliant, blue sky, the two start their race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon breaks off in the lead, but Manhattan Cafe is in close pursuit. Then, as they enter the last stretch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe appears to vanish from sight altogether! It looks almost like an actual shadow is chasing after Agnes Tachyon…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa whoa, you can't just spring that on me! What was that last-minute sprint all about?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To borrow your words, it was as if you came out from the shadows! Until you were right on me, you were practically invisible!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well, you never know… Perhaps I really did emerge from the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! I laugh, but I'm not sure you're even joking!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The shadows, huh… They say racewear can bring a sense of calm and euphoria to a runner, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Triggering a supernatural phenomenon puts your racewear in a league of its own!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll have to analyze the footage and find out exactly what happened just now!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …What did you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It was like you vanished into thin air.
It was like you vanished into thin air.
Is your signature racewear somehow connected to the shadows?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe, just as planned… You see, I concealed myself in the shadows…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I asked the designer to ensure that my racewear would allow me to sink into the shadows…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This outfit makes me one with the darkness… Plus, I can see the world more clearly from the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Now, even if a race is held somewhere bright, I can compete comfortably.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I now have a better understanding of Manhattan Cafe's connection with the shadows. Perhaps they are her greatest ally.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes… That's right.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: As I mentioned… everything is clear to me while I'm in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In the light, all I can see of my opponents is their appearance… but from the shadows, I see everything… Their spirit, their hopes—everything they carry with them…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This racewear will help me perform better than ever…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That perspective matches her love of the unseen. I'm positive she'll be able to make even better use of her true strength now.
